title: GameScores
description: Availability, errors and resources of GameScores.

panels.title: Online
panels.description: A check of the tailnet address each minute. This tests DNS, Tailscale, TLS and the application.

panels.title: Starts, 7d
panels.description: From a deploy or a crash.

panels.title: Errors, 24h
panels.description: ASP.NET log lines at the fail or crit level.

panels.title: Cert expires
panels.description: The time until the TLS certificate of the tailnet address expires.

panels.title: Replays
panels.description: Times that people selected to play a game again in the selected time.

panels.title: Rooms created
panels.description: New rooms in the selected time. Rooms that browsers restore after a restart do not count.

panels.title: Joins
panels.description: Times that people joined a room in the selected time.

panels.title: Rooms and players
panels.description: Rooms in use, idle rooms, and users in rooms.

panels.title: Rooms by game
panels.description: Rooms in use for each game. Games with no rooms do not show.

panels.title: Players by game
panels.description: Users in rooms for each game. Games with no players do not show.

panels.title: Games played
panels.description: Counts in the selected time. A restart sets the counters to 0, so a range that includes a restart can show too few.

panels.title: Games that people asked for
panels.description: Requests for a game that GameScores does not have. These are the lines with game_not_found. It is empty when nobody asked for a missing game, and also if this release does not write the line.

panels.title: Live connections
panels.description: Browsers connected for live scores. If this falls while rooms stay in use, clients lose their connection.

panels.title: Response time
panels.description: From the tailnet probe. Server processing is the time that the application took to answer.

panels.title: Log lines by level
panels.description: The default ASP.NET console log format.
